Commentary.Commentary: The Indian bowling, on the other hand, was flat to start off with. The pace bowlers had no answers to the early onslaught and it all came down to their spinners who once again came to the fore. The spin twin of Kuldeep and Chahal got the ball to grip and brought the game back in the favour of the hosts. Combined, they took 6 wickets in 20 overs and gave away only 88 runs, sensational stuff! The Lankan bowlers will have to bowl out of their skins if they are to restrict the home side. The wicket is offering assistance to the spinners and they would feel if they can get the openers early, they can stand themselves a chance as the hosts' middle order is fairly inexperienced. Will they be able to win their first ODI series on Indian soil? Join us in a bit for the run chase...

A stunning comeback by the Indians have seen them head into the break as a happier side. After being asked to bat, Sri Lanka lost Gunathilaka early but that didn't seem to hamper their aggressive approach at all. Upul Tharanga and Sadeera Samarawickrama started to attack and took everyone by surprise. They shared a blazing 121-run stand off 113 balls before the latter departed. Still the visitors were going great guns, but the wicket of Tharanga just changed the complexion of the game. From 160-2, they got wrapped up for a paltry 215, losing their next 8 wickets for just 55 runs.

OUT! That's it! Kumar wraps it up. He gets his first of the match. He lands it on a length outside off, Gunaratne tries to guide it down towards third man but gets an outside edge to Dhoni who pouches it. SRI LANKA HAVE BEEN BOWLED OUT FOR 215!
Comes down the track, seeing that Kumar bowls a short ball on off. Gunaratne guides it to point.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Back of a length on off, Asela pushes it to covers.
Shorter in length on off, cut to point.
Bhuvneshwar Kumar is back into the attack.

Floats it around off, turning away. Pradeep is beaten as he tries to defend. Fourth time in this over the batsman has been beaten. Chahal is unlucky he did not get an edge there. Nevertheless, Pradeep survives the over. Yuzvendra finishes off his spell with excellent figures of 10-3-46-3.
Bowled on the stumps, defended by the batsman.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Three in a row! This one also stays low. Chahal floats it on off, the ball turns away from the batsman and also stays low. Pradeep tries to keep it out but gets beaten.
BEATEN AGAIN! Flatter this time on middle, gets it to turn away. Pradeep does not play for the turn and is undone by it.
Beauty to start with! Chahal tosses it up on middle and then gets it to turn away sharply. Pradeep tries to defend but gets beaten.
Yuzvendra Chahal is brought back into the attack.
No run off the last ball! Full and wide outside off, Gunaratne fails to put bat to it and Pradeep will be on strike for the next over.
Fuller in length, driven to mid on.
Good length outside off, Gunaratne guides it down to third man and refuses to run.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
Full and wide outside off, Asela tries to jam it out but gets beaten.

Shorter in length outside off, Asela cuts it through point. The batsmen complete one and then run for the second. Hardik at third man gets to the ball and throws it at the bowler's end. Bumrah collects it and tries to throw it back onto the stumps but misses. Two taken by the batsmen.
Jasprit Bumrah is back into the attack.

Slower through the air on middle, Asela comes down the track and tries to drive. He gets an inside edge onto his pads in doing so. The ball rolls towards the leg side and the batsmen take a run. Gunaratne retains strike for the next over.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Drags his length back on middle, Asela lets the ball do its bit and then punches it to covers.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Shorter in length on off, pushed to covers off the back foot.
Back of a length outside off, Nuwan first thinks of playing at it but then moves his bat out of the way.
Another short ball but this is down the leg side. Pradeep evades it but the umpire calls a wide.
Slower short ball on middle, Pradeep tries to go over mid-wicket but gets beaten.
Bouncer! The batsman ducks under it.
Good length on off, Pradeep defends it solidly.
Nuwan Pradeep the new man defends the ball off the front foot.

OUT! Lakmal is walking back now! Pandya with his second. He lands it on off, gets it to shape back in. Lakmal tries to drive but is beaten by the inswing. The ball hits him on the front pad and the Indians appeal. Pandya is celebrating even before he has started appealing and the umpire raises his finger. Lakmal straightaway starts walking to the dressing room as he knows he is a goner. Nuwan Pradeep will be last man in now.
Powerplay 3 has been signaled. Now a maximum of 5 fielders can be placed outside the circle.
The batsman plays the pull shot. They pick up a single.
Suranga Lakmal strides out at no. 10.

OUT! BOWLED 'EM! They are falling like a pack of cards here. Kuldeep gets his third and the move to bring him on has paid dividends immediately. He floats it full on leg stump, Dananjaya goes down on one knee and tries to sweep it but misses and the ball hits the stumps. Not a good idea to sweep the ball which is so full.
Very full outside off, Gunaratne drives it through covers for a run.
Floats it up on off, Akila sweeps it through square leg for a run.
Slower through the air on off, defended by the batsman.
Tosses it up on middle, Akila works it to leg slip.
Kuldeep Yadav is back into the attack. He has a slip and a leg slip in place.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket.
Akila Dananjaya is the next man in.

OUT! In the air... gone! Pandya gets his first! Pathirana wanted to go big but fails to get the timing right. A length delivery on the stumps, Sachith swings his bat but gets it off the toe-end of the bat towards mid on. Chahal there backpedals a bit and takes a safe catch. What a turnaround this is from India. Will Sri Lanka play out their quota of 50 overs?
Comes down the track again, it's short on leg, pulled towards fine leg for a single.
Skips down the track and pulls it through mid-wicket for a couple.
On the leg stump, helped down to fine leg for a single.
Hardik Pandya is back into the attack.
Comes forward and drives it towards the man at mid-wicket. A maiden for Chahal. His figures now read - 9-2-46-3!
Quicker through the air outside off, driven towards mid off for nothing.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Presses forward and blocks it back to the bowler.
Slows it through the air, outside off, Asela looks to defend but the ball turns away and he gets beaten.
Around middle and leg, worked towards short fine leg.
Hangs back and tucks it towards the man at short mid-wicket.
The batsman was beaten and missed the line of the delivery.
Stands tall and pokes it towards point.

Chance of a run out! Kumar fails to collect the ball and Asela Gunaratne gets a huge reprieve! Angles it away outside off, Pathirana taps it towards point where Karthik makes a diving stop to his left. Asela wants the single and is almost at the other end before his partner sends him back. Dinesh throws it back to the bowler but Kumar fails to collect the ball which allows Gunaratne to get back in.
Angles it in from around middle, worked off the inner half through square leg for a single.
Kumar starts off with a full ball, a bit wide outside off, Pathirana flays it over cover-point for a single.
Bhuvneshwar Kumar is back on.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

EDGY FOUR! Pathirana won't mind though. Chahal bowls a googly outside off. Pathirana tries to force it through the off side but gets an outside edge through the slip region for a boundary. Dhoni after that asks Chahal not to bowl that line as there is no slip in place.
Floats it on middle, gets it to turn back in. Pathirana tries to defend but the ball takes the pads and goes towards leg gully who takes it and appeals but the umpire shakes his head.
The batsman gets to the pitch of the ball and defends it.
Sachith Pathirana is the next man in.

OUT! That is plumb! The Indian spinners have turned it around completely. Chahal gets his third and the dangerous Perera is walking back. Once again, the turning ball is causing the problems for the Sri Lankan batsmen. Chahal lands it outside off and gets it to turn back sharply. The ball was also bowled a touch quicker and hence Thisara gets beaten as he is late to defend it off the back foot. The ball sneaks through and hits the back pad. The Indian players appeal and the umpire raises his finger immediately. Perera walks up to his partner and after a chat, reviews it. Replays roll in and Ultra Edge shows there is no bat involved and Hawk Eye shows it to be umpire's call which is out. Perera is given his marching orders. Sri Lanka though don't lose a review as it is umpire's call. Another one bites the dust for the Lankans and now the Indians will hope to wrap it up quickly.
Thisara is a goner! He has been adjudged LBW but after a chat with Asela he reviews. To be honest only an inside edge can save him there.
Works it towards mid-wicket for a run.
A bumper on middle, Asela pulls it through square leg for a run.
Driven towards the mid off region. One run added to the total.
Fuller in length outside off, Perera drives it through covers for a brace.

Bowled on middle, Perera flicks it through mid-wicket. The batsmen complete two. Thisara wanted the third but is sent back by his partner. There is a chance for a run out but the throw is at the wrong end.
Length on off, Asela plays it down towards third man for a run.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Thisara Perera, the skipper, walks out to the middle.

OUT! TIMBER! Mathews is walking back. A huge wicket for the Indians. This is also the first time he has been dismissed in this series and it's a gem to get rid of him. Chahal bowls a flighted ball, which first drifts into the batsman, pitches on middle and then turns away sharply. Mathews lunges forward but does not play for the turn and eventually gets undone by it. The ball hits the top of off and Yuzvendra is ecstatic. Mathews can't believe what just happened and slowly starts to trudge back. Sri Lanka are completely losing the plot and the Indian spinners are once again weaving their magic.
Rocks onto the back foot and pushes the ball towards mid-wicket. The fielder there dives but can't stop it and the batsmen take one.
Tosses it up on middle, the batsman defends it solidly.
Quicker but shorter in length on middle, Angelo punches it down to long on for a run.
Slower through the air on off, turning away. Mathews defends it off the front foot.
Drinks time!
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
This time he pulls the short ball through mid-wicket for a run.
Some chin music for the batsman who ducks under it.

FOUR! Save your head Asela! Mathews comes down the track, expecting a length ball. He gets one and bludgeons it straight back past the bowler. Asela at the other end had to move out of the way quickly as the ball races to the long on fence for a rocketing boundary.

EXCELLENT FIELDING! Dinesh Karthik has surely saved three runs for his side. Shorter in length outside off by Bumrah. Asela cuts it towards point where Karthik dives to his right and makes an excellent stop. The batsman in the meantime take a run.
Shortish ball outside off, Gunaratne tries to cut but chops it towards point.
Jasprit Bumrah who was impressive in his first spell is back into the attack.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
It's been driven superbly through the covers for no runs.
Nails the sweep with the spin through square leg. The fielder in the deep runs to his left and makes a goo diving stop. The batsmen run one.
WIDE! Lands it on leg stump, spinning away. Gunaratne misses the flick and the umpire again signals a wide, second in the over.
Driven to long on for a run.
Floats it on off, Asela drives it through mid on for a run.
Fuller outside off, Gunaratne drives it to covers.
WIDE! Spills it down the leg side. Asela fails to flick it and the umpire signals a wide.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Shorter in length around leg stump. Asela fails to pull it. The ball brushes the pads and goes down towards fine leg for a leg bye.
Works it with the angle to mid-wicket.
Back of a length on off, Gunaratne defends it off the back foot.
Length outside off, Gunaratne taps it towards third man. Dhoni gets to the ball quickly with one glove off, to stop a run.
Good length on off, Asela defends it stoutly.
Flicks the tossed up ball on middle to mid-wicket.
Played to mid-wicket region by the batsman.
Works it with the spin through mid-wicket for a run.
Fuller in length, driven down to long on for a run.
Drags his length back outside off. Mathews reads it was the googly, as he rocks back and pushes it through covers for a brace.
That was nicely flighted around off, turning into the batsman. Gunaratne tries to drive it through the off side but it goes off the inner half through mid on for a run.
The batsman has driven it through mid off.
A bumper on middle, Asela gets over the bounce and pulls it along the ground, down towards fine leg for a run.
Bouncer! A well-directed one. Gunaratne does well to evade it.
Slightly shorter in length on off, Gunaratne defends it off the back foot.
Length on middle, Asela defends it off the front foot.
Angles it on the pads, Mathews flicks it through mid-wicket for a run.
Change of ends for Hardik Pandya.
Presses forward and blocks it down. A successful over from Kuldeep, this.
Asela Gunaratne walks in next. He got a start in the previous game and needs to play a sensible innings now.

OUT! Guided straight to first slip! Two quick wickets and Kuldeep Yadav has turned it on here! The bowling change has worked for Rohit Sharma. Dickwella comes and perishes! Smart bowling from Yadav. He once again bowls a slower delivery outside off, Dickwella once again tries to repeat the previous shot but this time he guides it straight into the hands of Shreyas Iyer at first slip. Sri Lanka are in a bit of bother now.

FOUR! Nicely done! Slower through the air, outside off, Dickwella goes back and guides it past the first slip fielder for another boundary. Pandya in the deep does well to stop but the ball still wins the race.
Bowls it outside off, looks to drive but gets beaten.
FOUR! Dickwella is off the mark straightaway! On middle and leg, Niroshan gets down and paddle sweeps it through backward square leg for a boundary to get going.
Niroshan Dickwella is the next man in.

OUT! Stumped! Tharanga fails to drag his leg back. Yadav comes and strikes immediately! But credit to one man, MS Dhoni! He is just too good behind the stumps, isn't he? Another big wicket as Tharanga was looking really dangerous. Kuldeep tosses it up outside off, Upul looks to drive it but the ball turns away and he gets beaten. Dhoni behind the stumps collects the ball and waits for a bit and then takes the bails off. He appeals and the umpire refers it upstairs. Replays show Tharanga hasn't dragged his back leg behind. It's firmly on the crease and the Giant Screen flashes OUT! Tharanga has been dismissed for the first time in the 90s in his career.

And an appeal straightaway. Dhoni removes the bails and appeals for a stumping. It has been taken upstairs. He isn't that confident though. Has Tharanga dragged his leg behind the line? Let's wait and find out...
Kuldeep Yadav comes back into the attack, replacing Pandya.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Shorter in length around off, Mathews waits for it to turn and pushes it to point.
Brings out the sweep shot through square leg for a run.
SIX! Tharanga is dealing in maximums here. He is into the 90s now. Chahal again tosses it up on middle, right in the zone for Upul. He once again launches it over long on for a maximum. Clean strike!
Tosses it up outside off, Angelo drives it through mid off for a run.
Sweeps it down the leg side for a run.
Length ball, defended off the back foot.
Works it with the angle to mid-wicket.
Again, Mathews tries to go for it by coming down the track. This time Hardik bowls an off pace ball outside off and Angelo gets beaten.

FOUR! This is very good batting by Lanka! All the batsmen who have come out have attacked the bowlers and it is working for them until now. Mathews comes down the track to the length ball on off. He lofts it over mid off for a boundary.
Shorter in length on middle, Tharanga pulls it through mid-wicket for a run.
Back of a length on middle, Mathews tries to flick but misses to get hit on the thigh pad. The ball rolls towards the leg side and the batsmen take a leg bye.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
SIX! This will break the shackles! Once again, a flighted ball on off. Tharanga sees it is in his arc and goes big as he lofts it over long on for a maximum.
WIDE! Fires it down the leg side. Tharanga fails to flick and the umprie signals a wide.
Slower through the air on middle, turning back in. Upul tries to sweep but misses as the ball goes off the pads towards short fine leg.
Sweeps it but straight to the man at short fine leg. They have brought in that man to stop the sweep shot.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.
Short and outside off, tapped in front of cover-point for nothing.
On a length and around middle and leg, tucked around the corner for a single.
Back of a length, angling across, Tharanga tries to run this one down to third man but gets beaten.
Bangs in a short ball, Angelo is on his toes as he works it through square leg for a single to open his account.
A bit short and on middle and off, defended once again off the back foot.
Back of a length delivery, stays behind and blocks it out.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery. A wicket maiden by Chahal just what India needed.
Shorter in length, played to point.
Works it with the spin to mid-wicket.
Angelo Mathews walks out to the middle. He is fresh of a ton in the last game. Can he replicate his form here?

OUT! Chahal provides the breakthrough and the crowd erupts. A much-needed one for the Indians. A false shot again by Sadeera, he has been riding his luck throughout the innings but this time he runs out of it. Yuzvendra tosses it up outside off, gets it to turn away. Samarawickrama comes down the track but does not quite get to the pitch of the ball. He still tries to go inside out but only manages to slice it to the man at sweeper cover. Dhawan there positions himself under it and takes it. He also performs his trademark celebration which they call it as a thigh-five by turning towards the crowd. Sadeera walks back after getting a start. The 121-run stand comes to an end. Can India now build on this?
Driven through the covers by the batsman.
Flighted ball on leg stump, Sadeera tries to work it on the leg side but misses to get hit on the pads.
Bouncer! The batsman does well to evade it.
Some chin music for the batsman, he lets that bouncer through to the wicketkeeper.
A short delivery which has been pulled away. One run added to the total.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They manage to come back for the second.
FOUR! Excellent timing! Shorter in length outside off by Pandya. Sadeera times it through backward point and such is the outfield that the ball races to the fence.
Driven through mid on by the batsman.
Hardik Pandya is back into the attack. He was expensive in his first spell, can he turn it around?
FOUR! They have played the sweep shot to great effect against Chahal. He once again bowls it on middle, Tharanga goes down on one knee and sweeps it fine down the leg side for a boundary.
The batsman dances down the track and drives it uppishly towards sweeper cover. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Floats it on off, turning into the batsman. Upul clips it on the leg side for a run.
Tosses it up on off, driven to extra cover for no run.
The batsman works it down the leg side.
Works it against the spin through the leg side for a run.
The batsman has driven it through mid on. One run added to the total.

NOT OUT! The Indians never seemed very interested. Sadeera guides the ball on off towards short third man. He sets off for a run but then is sent back by his partner as there was never a run there. The fielder fires a throw to Dhoni who takes the bails off in a flash as Sadeera dives to get back in. The players appeal but not with a lot of conviction and the umpire takes it upstairs. Replays show that he has made his crease comfortably.
They have gone upstairs to check for a run out against Sadeera. None of the Indians seem confident. The dive must have saved Samarawickrama.
Nails the sweep through square leg for a couple.
It's been driven superbly through the covers. They pick up a single.

DROPPED! A tough one but should have been taken at this level. Yadav gives it air on middle. Seeing the flight, Sadeera comes down the track and tries to flick it over mid-wicket. He does not get the elevation desired. The ball goes towards Dinesh Karthik who laps high and tries to take it but can't. He then recovers and tries to take it on the second attempt but fails to get to it. A run taken by the batsmen in the meantime.
Works it with the spin towards mid-wicket.

FOUR! That biggie is playing on the mind of Chahal! He again bowls it short and outside off. Too easy for Tharanga as he rocks back and cuts it through cover-point for a boundary. 14 runs from the over and the 100-run stand comes up as well.
The batsman charges down the wicket. The batsmen have run through for a single.
The previous shot has made Chahal drag his length back. Upul pulls him through mid-wicket for a run.
SIX! That has gone up and over the fence! What a shot! Chahal gives it air on middle, Tharanga lofts it over the bowler's head for a maximum.
Comes down the track, Chahal seeing that shortens his length, also bowls it flatter. Sadeera adjusts and tries to defend but is struck on the pads. The ball rolls towards the off side for a leg bye.
Floats it on middle, Tharanga sweeps it down towards fine leg for a run.
Leans ahead and pushes it towards the man at mid off.
Fuller on middle, jammed out past the bowler down to long off for one.

Beautiful! Yadav is not afraid to toss the ball up. He once again does so, lands it just outside off. Tharanga gets down on one knee to slog sweep it but the ball turns away to beat him all ends up. This wasn't far from the off pole either.
Uses the feet to a loopy delivery and drives it towards long off to rotate strike.
A bit too full this time, driven through mid on for a single.
Yadav tosses it up around off, Tharanga prods forward to drive but the ball grips and then turns away to leave him stunned.

Drinks are on the field. This is some start for Sri Lanka. They have come out with a lot of intent and it has worked so far for them. Tharanga has already notched up his fifty while Samarawickrama has done justice to his selection. The Indians need to break this stand and it will be interesting to see if the spinners can put a lid on the scoring rate now...

Slightly shorter in length around off, spinning in. Tharanga, easily works it towards mid-wicket to change strike. 100 up for Lanka and that too in quick time. They will be delighted with how things have gone.
Works it with the spin to mid-wicket.
The batsman has driven it through mid off. The batsmen have run through for a single.
A half-tracker on middle, Upul pulls it through mid-wicket for a run.
Tosses it up outside off, turning back in. Tharanga tries to defend but gets an inside edge onto his pads. Dhoni appeals but then pulls out of it.
Shorter in length on middle, Tharanga mistimes his pull to mid-wicket.
So spin from both ends now. Yuzvendra Chahal to roll his arm over. Let's see what the leggie can do here.
Drags his length back on off, Tharanga waits for the ball to do its bit and then pushes it through covers for a run.
The batsman charges down the wicket. They pick up a single.
A googly on middle, Tharanga, this time reads it and flicks it through the leg side for a run.
Works it with the spin towards mid-wicket for a run.
Driven towards the mid off region.

FOUR! TOP SHOT! Sadeera has used his feet exceptionally well and here is an example. He charges down the track and gets to the pitch of the ball. He lofts it straight back past the bowler to collect a boundary.
Played to mid-wicket region by the batsman.

Another top edge which lands safe! India need a wicket desperately but luck is not on their side. Kumar bangs it short on middle, Samarawickrama goes for the pull but is undone by the bounce. He gets a top edge down towards fine leg where the fielder fails to get to it. A single taken by the batsmen.
Bouncer on middle. Sadeera pulls it through mid-wicket. Chahal in the deep runs to his left and stops the ball with a dive but can't prevent two.
Fullish in length on off. Pushed towards cover for a run.
Straighter in line. The batsman works it around the corner for a run.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Played through mid wicket by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.

Another appeal and this one is very close! India don't review again and have they missed a chance? Kuldeep once again bowls it on around middle and off, but a touch fuller this time. He gets it to turn into the batsman who tries to flick but misses. Sadeera is struck on the front pad and the Indians appeal. The umpire shakes his head. Rohit after having a word with Dhoni opts not to review. But the Indians should have there as Hawk Eye later shows three reds. Some luck for Sadeera here.
Samarawickrama is nimble on his feet and drives it beautifully but straight to covers.
Driven through mid on by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.

Cracking delivery! Kuldeep bowls a googly which completely foxes Upul. He fails to read it and tries to defend it leaving a gap between bat and pad. The ball sneaks through and goes extremely close to the off pole.
Works it with the spin, around the corner for a run.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

OUCH! That has hit him flush on his helmet! Kumar once again bangs it short on middle, Samarawickrama comes down the track and tries to pull. But is late on the shot this time and is hit on the helmet. The ball rolls lobs towards square leg and the batsmen take a leg bye. The good thing here is the batsman is fine.

FOUR! Uppish but in the gap! All the luck going Sri Lanka's way here. Kumar bangs it short as Sadeera was walking down the pitch quite often. Samarawickrama still takes on the challenge of pulling it. He gets a top edge but between fine leg and deep square leg for a boundary.
Length on middle, Upul works it towards mid-wicket and sets off for a run. The fielder there goes for the direct hit but misses. One run added to the total.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Starts off around the wicket. Tharanga flicks it with the angle through square leg for a brace.
Bhuvneshwar Kumar is back into the attack. Can he break this stand?

HOWZAAT! A big appeal from the Indians but the umpire shakes his head. Kuldeep lands it on off and gets it to turn into the right-hander. Sadeera plants his front foot across and tries to work it on the leg side. He misses and is hit on the pads in the process. The Indians appeal but the umpire shakes his head. The Indian players are not interested to review it and Haw Eye later confirms it is going over the stumps. Good decision by the Indians.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
Uses his feet and tries to flick but mistimes it towards mid-wicket.
Slower through the air on middle, the googly by Kuldeep. The batsman tries to flick but gets a soft leading edge, back to the bowler.
Floats it outside off, Sadeera goes for the sweep but fails to connect. The ball brushes the pad and goes to first slip. Kuldeep starts appealing but is the only one to do so.

FIFTY FOR THARANGA! His 36th in ODIs and it has come off just 36 balls. It has been an exciting innings so far and he has to make it big if Sri Lanka are to get to a decent total here. Kuldeep dishes out a fuller ball on off, Upul drives it towards long off for a run.
Time for spin! Kuldeep Yadav is into the attack.
Fuller in length around off, the batsman pushes it to mid off. 24 from Pandya's last two overs.
FOUR! This spoils the over! Pandya bowls it on middle, Sadeera walks across and flicks it through square leg for a boundary. Pandya has conceded 6 boundaries in his last 11 balls.
Bouncer! His go-to ball. He lands it on off, Sadeera thinks about pulling it but then holds back at the last moment to let it be.
Just short of a length outside off, Sadeera guides it towards point. Iyer there dives to his left and makes a good stop.
Length on off, the batsman defends it solidly.
Works it with the angle to mid-wicket.
Powerplay 2 has been signaled. Now a maximum of 4 fielders can be placed outside the circle till the 40th over.
Played to the point region by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single. End of the first Powerplay, a good start for Sri Lanka after an early wicket.
Length outside off, Tharanga opens the face of his bat and guides it down to third man for a run.
Changes his angle and comes around the wicket. Bumrah angles it on the pads. Upul fails to flick it as the ball brushes the pads and goes to short fine leg.
Shorter in length around off, Sadeera guides it towards third man for a run.
Back of a length on middle, gets extra bounce off the pitch. The ball hits Sadeera high on the bat as he tries to defend. Bumrah is getting extra bounce as compared to the other bowlers.

Too good! Bumrah has been excellent uptil now. He once again bowls it around off, first angles it in and the gets some outward movement after pitching. Sadeera lunges forward and tries to defend but gets beaten.
A dot ball! Fuller outside off, defended towards cover. 20 runs from the over, a big one!

FOUR! 5 in a row! Upul Tharanga is in the mood now! This is the best of the lot! Once again keeps it full, slower in pace. UT stands tall and hits it off the meat over mid off for another boundary. Runs coming at a quick pace for the Lankans.

FOUR! Edgyyyy! Pandya doesn't know what to do now! Slower this time, just outside off, Tharanga looks to drive again but gets another edge towards Dhoni. The ball dies down in front of the keeper who in spite of a dive to his left couldn't stop it. The ball races away towards the fence again. 16 already from the over! Also, brings up the 50-run stand between the two.
FOUR! Up and past the man at mid off! Fuller in length and outside off, Tharanga decides to go after it. Chips it aerially past the diving mid off fielder for the third boundary of the over.

FOUR! And again! Not off the middle but had enough the clear mid on! Fuller and angling in, Upul chips it over mid on. The fielder there was interested but the ball sails over him and goes to the fence for back-to-back boundaries.

FOUR! Edged and away! Pandya from around the wicket, hurls a length delivery outside off, Tharanga looks to go hard at it. Gets a thick outside edge through the vacant slip cordon for a boundary to start the over.
Fuller in length driven to mid off. A maiden by Bumrah. The first of the innings.
Works it with the angle to mid-wicket.
Fuller in length outside off, Samarawickrama tries to drive with minimal foot movement. The ball goes off the outer half towards point where Pandey makes a decent stop.
Comes down the track but not quite to the pitch of the ball. Sadeera defends it stoutly.
OHHHH! That whizzes past the edge! Bumrah is bowling really well here. He lands it on a length around off, gets it to straighten. Sadeera tries to defend but gets beaten.
Back of a length outside off, Samarawickrama stands tall and taps it to point.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Back of a length on off, pushed to point.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Short outside off, again. Tharanga goes for the cut but this one bounces a touch extra and beats him.
FOUR! Poor ball and dispatched! Short and wide by Pandya outside off, Tharanga cashes in on the width offered and cuts it through point. Kuldeep in the deep runs to his left but can't get to it.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
First bowling change for today. Hardik Pandya is brought into the attack. A forced change maybe as 22 runs have been hit off the last two overs.

NOT OUT! That is an easy decision, should have never been taken upstairs. Samarawickrama tries to defend the length ball around off by coming down the track. He gets an outside edge in the process towards first slip. Dhawan crouches low to take it but is not sure whether it is clean or not. The umpires to be very sure go upstairs and replays show it has bounced before going into the hands. Samarawickrama played that with soft hands and that is what saved him there.
Sadeera has edged it towards first slip, Dhawan crouches low to take it but is not sure. The umpires have gone upstairs to check but the soft signal is not out.
The batsman rocks onto the backfoot and punches the ball. One run added to the total.
Bumrah bowls a slower ball on off. Tharanga reads it well and just times it through covers for a couple.
FOUR! They are dealing in boundaries here! Poor line again! Bumrah again sprays it on the pads, Tharanga gets across and tickles it fine down the leg side for a boundary. Back-to-back for Lanka.
FOUR! Sprays on the pads, too easy for Tharanga, he loves it there. He flicks it over square leg to fetch himself another boundary.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Kumar changes his angle and comes around the wicket. He dishes out a full ball on off, Tharanga pushes it towards mid off for a run. 11 runs from the over.
FOUR! Crunched! 10 runs from the last 3 balls. Shorter in length around middle, Tharanga gets on top of the bounce and pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Sprays on the pads, Tharanga flicks it uppishly but over the square leg fielder for a couple. The Sri Lankan batsmen have come out with an attacking approach here.
FOUR! Tharanga gets into the act this time. Kumar bowls it fuller on off, Upul lofts it over mid on and it goes on the bounce, over the fence for a boundary.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
BEAUTIFUL! Kumar bowls it on middle, gets it to shape away after pitching. Tharanga again tries to defend but gets beaten.

Plays it towards the right of Bumrah and sets off for a run. Seeing Bumrah get to the ball quickly, Sadeera has to turn back. He slips in doing so but is quick to recover and puts in a dive. Bumrah has a shy but misses. No harm done.
FOUR! Off the mark in style! Bumrah bowls it on middle, Sadeera walks across and flicks it through mid-wicket. Pandya hares after it, puts in a dive but all in vain.
Sadeera Samarawickrama strides out at no. 3.

OUT! One shot too many by Gunathilaka! He once again comes down the track and tries to go big. Seeing him coming down, Bumrah hits it hard on a length. Gunathilaka still goes on with the shot, even though he was not to the pitch of the ball. He does not get the desired connection and mistimes it straight to mid on. Rohit Sharma stationed there takes it easily. An early strike for India, just what they needed. A disappointed Danushka walks back. He showed a lot of intent but you need to do it wisely against a quality attack.
Works it towards mid-wicket for a run.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.

BEATEN! Lovely delivery! Bumrah lands it on a length around middle, gets it to shape away after pitching. Tharanga tries to defend but gets beaten. We saw him being beaten in the first ODI a lot of times on a similar delivery.

FOUR! Gunathilaka has opted for an attacking approach! He comes down the track to the ball which is not that short and pulls it through square leg and fetches himself a boundary. He might have been given the license from the dressing room to go after the bowlers.

He does now! Bowled on middle by Bhuvi. Tharanga pushes it towards mid on and sets off for a run. Sharma is quick to the ball and scores a direct hit at the non-striker's end but Tharanga has made his ground.
Played to mid-wicket by the batsman.

Fuller in length on middle, Tharanga pushes it to the right of the bowler and starts to take a run but has to get back quickly as Kumar moves swiftly to his right and collects the ball. Tharanga is eager to get off the mark here.
Just ahead of a length on off, Upul pushes it towards mid off. He initially thinks about a run but then opts against it.
Shorter in length outside off, Tharanga chops it towards point.
Slower one on off, Gunathilaka reads it well and defends it. All 9 runs for Sri Lanka have come off the bat of Gunathilaka.

Bumrah bowls it fuller this time on middle, Gunathilaka flicks it through mid-wicket. He completes a run and slips at the non-striker's end as he goes for the second. He still continues and makes it in the end.

In the air...but in the gap! Bumrah, once again lands it on a length around off, gets it to bounce extra. Gunathilaka, tries to drive but is early into his shot. The ball goes uppishly but through the vacant cover-point region for a couple.
Shorter in length around off, the batsman pushes it to point.
Length ball around middle, Gunathilaka flicks it to mid-wicket.
BOUNCE! Bumrah lands it on a length around off, gets it to bounce extra. Danushka, defends it towards point. The ball hits the top of the bat there. Good signs for Bumrah.
Jasprit Bumrah will bowl with the second new ball. He too has two slips in place.
A similar delivery to the last one. Tharanga once again walks across and clips it to mid-wicket. 5 runs from the first over.
Gets it to shape back in from middle, on a fuller length. Tharanga with the swing, flicks it to mid-wicket.
Shorter in length around off, Gunathiliaka tries to cut but the ball is too close for it. It flies of the edge and down to third man for a run.

FOUR! Great way to get going. That was hit with so much authority. All signs of the wicket being slow have been vanished with that shot. A length ball by Kumar just outside off, Gunathilaka, stands tall and strokes it on the up, through covers for a boundary.
Good length around off, swinging away. Danushka defends it solidly.

Starts off with a length ball around off, comes very slow off the surface. A little bit of swing away from the batsman. Gunathilaka tries to force it through the off side but gets an inside edge, back to the bowler.

Bright sunshine welcomes us here in Visakhapatnam. The Indian team is in a huddle near the boundary and now they walk to the middle. Upul Tharanga and Danushka Gunathilaka will open the batting for Sri Lanka. They will hope to provide their team with a good start. Bhuvneshwar Kumar will open the bowling for India. He has two slips in place. Here we go...
Both the teams along with the umpires walk out for their respective national anthems. The away side will sing first, followed by India's.

Sri Lankan skipper, Thisara Perera feels it is a really good wicket to bat on. He says they would want to put up a good score on the board. Opines the dew might come into play in the evening but the wicket is still good for batting and once again focuses on the need to get a big score. Admits they did not bowl well in the last game and would need to execute the plans properly today. Informs even they have made 1 change, SADEERA SAMARAWICKRAMA comes in place of Lahiru Thirimanne.

Indian skipper, Rohit Sharma says, they will bowl first. Opines it is hot for now but as the game goes on it will cool down. Mentions dew is the reason for them to bowl first. Admits a win in the last game was very important for them to stay alive in the series. Reckons everybody chipped in with the ball and bat. Further adds this team has got a lot of character and they take up the responsibility when needed. Informs there is one change to his side, Washington Sundar is unwell and KULDEEP YADAV comes into the side for him.
TOSS - Rohit flips the coin, Perera calls heads... but tails it is. And India win the toss for the first time in the series and elect to bowl first.

PITCH REPORT - Sunil Gavaskar and Russel Arnold feel this is a very good batting pitch. Further add it is nice and hard. Reckon the bowlers can get a little bit of bounce and lift as there is some grass in the middle. Opine the cracks won't make much of a difference as it is an ODI game. Win the toss and bowl first as dew might come into play later on, say the two.

On the other hand, India, head into the game as heavy favorites. They dissolved any queries of being a fragile batting line-up in the absence of Kohli in the last game. Rohit Sharma will hope for a repeat performance. The home side possess a strong bowling attack and they would like them to come to the fore today. Will we see the Sri Lankans cause an upset or will the Indians go on to clinch yet another series at home? We will have to wait to find out. Stay tuned for the toss and further updates.

Sri Lanka will be eager for a win today, as it would give them their long-awaited series win in India which will also be their first series win this year. Their batsmen will have to deliver with the bat and their bowlers cannot give away easy runs here. A collective effort is what they will need and that is exactly what Perera will be hoping for.

Many would have thought the series should be done and dusted by the third ODI but that's not the case. A whitewash was what a lot were expecting at the start of the series but here we are for the decider between India and Sri Lanka in Visakhapatnam, where both the teams have everything to play for. After two lopsided affairs let us hope that we get a close one here. Hello and welcome to our coverage, folks.
